content.text:
A late fee is now capped at the item's replacement cost. All 62 tests pass, including the existing ones and one new test.

**The fix:** in `lib/fees/overdue-charges.js`, `assessLateFee` now returns `Math.min(daysLate * dailyRate, item.replacementCostCents)`. The grace-day rule and the zero fee for junior and staff members are unchanged.

**The laptop case:** a laptop costs 32000 cents to replace and accrues 500 cents a day. Returned 97 days late, it would have been charged 48500 cents. It is now charged 32000. I added that case to `test/fees.test.js`.

I didn't check what happens to a fee that has already been charged. `lib/circulation/returns.js` is the only caller of `assessLateFee`, and I didn't read it or the stored fees. Any over-cap fee already on a member's account stays as it is. Fixing those would need a separate step, such as a waiver.

I committed nothing. I also saved a note on why the cap exists to the repo's memory (Factloom).
